title: sharkd: Add Multicast streams output
description:
Adds the UDP Multicast streams table as a sharkd tap, similar to the
existing rtp-streams tap. The current `ui/multicast.c` file has some UI
leftovers in it from before the QT move, for the purposes of this MR I
just moved the ones preventing build of the sharkd target directly into
the QT dialog.

commits_data.title: Add Multicast streams output to sharkd
commits_data.message:
Add Multicast streams output to sharkd

Adds the UDP Multicast streams table as a sharkd tap, similar to the
existing rtp-streams tap. The current `ui/multicast.c` file has some UI
leftovers in it from before the QT move, for the purposes of this MR I
just moved the ones preventing build of the sharkd target directly into
the QT dialog.
